Container.Name: mem-zero
Container.Overview: Project-isolated MCP memory server with embedded Qdrant and bundled LLM.
Container.Description: Project-isolated MCP memory server with embedded Qdrant vector database. Includes a bundled LLM for self-contained operation, or connect to Ollama/OpenAI.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Web dashboard and MCP server HTTP port

Config.Name: Qdrant Port
Config.Description: Qdrant API port (optional, for direct access)

Config.Name: LLM Backend
Config.Description: LLM backend: bundled (self-contained), ollama, or openai. Auto-detected if not set.

Config.Name: Ollama URL
Config.Description: Ollama API base URL (only used when backend=ollama)

Config.Name: LLM Model
Config.Description: Ollama language model (only used when backend=ollama)

Config.Name: Embedder Model
Config.Description: Ollama embedding model (only used when backend=ollama)

Config.Name: OpenAI API Key
Config.Description: API key for OpenAI-compatible backend (only used when backend=openai)

Config.Name: Dashboard Username
Config.Description: Username for web dashboard login (leave empty to disable auth)
